notes.title: A Pit of Variety
notes.notes:
Hello

We've added a bit more variety to the pits added in the last update, as well as fixed a couple of minor glitches

The change affects the width and placement of the pits, giving more variety in their appearance rather than affecting gameplay too much

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705266/1e0f8d7d434df9666a0d6b5538d479cf4dfffcc7.png[/img]

The glitches fixed were aslo visual in nature, relating to the underground areas, and would have only affected some players

We hope you like the update

notes.title: Pits and Ladders
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

We've made some improvements to Steampunk Graveyard with a few tweaks and additions in our Pits and Ladders update, just in time for Halloween

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705266/6a477016f1336f6183a703bdb1d6d3a400e9cc2e.png[/img]

The changes include:
- Ladders are easier to climb with the player sticking to them better
- Pits have been added in the underground area that can provide areas to hide or additional danger
- Tweaked the level generation to encourage more exploration of both the above and below ground areas
- The large brain-powered mechanoids now bounce you away if you try to run past them

If you don't already have the game, we have a 50% off sale running from October 21st to November 4th and you can buy the game in a bundle with our other games for an extra discount.

notes.title: A New Price
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've dropped the price and we're having a sale!

It's been a few years since we released Steampunk Graveyard, so we thought it might be time to permanently lower the price

To celebrate the new price, we're running a sale and we've discounted the price even further - a strange way to celebrate a price drop, we know!

We've also similarly reduced the price of our other games that have been out for a few years too - get them all in a bundle for an extra discount

Anyway, we hope you like the new price

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
We've given Steampunk Graveyard a significant update for Halloween with a new game mode as well as various fixes and improvements

The update includes:
- New "Daily Challenge" mode with a repeatable level
- Health bottles no longer destroyed by bullets
- Additional background details for Halloween
- Giant Mecha-Zombies crush obstacles in their path and block grenades
- Fixed issue with the Baron not appearing correctly in some levels
- Reworked cinematic scenes

We hope you enjoy this update

notes.title: Quality of Unlife Update
notes.notes:
We've made a few quality of life (or unlife) changes that should improve the gameplay experience and overall make Steampunk Graveyard more fun to play.

The main changes include:
- Reduced loading times for levels
- Additional visual and audio indicator when enemies are killed
- Additional visual diversity in levels
- Reduced damage from explosions and gas clouds
- Grenade throwing enemies better able to launch over obstacles

There was also an engine update and a few settigns tweaks.

If you've not yet purchased Steampunk Graveyard, we will be putting the game on sale soon, so keep an eye out for that.

notes.title: Story & Control
notes.notes:
While working on our new game, Gorilla Guerrillas, we added remappable controls and we thought "why not add that to Steampunk Graveyard too?", so we did and here's the update.

Included in update:
- Remappable keyboard and gamepad controls
- A short story mode added to ease player into the game
- Random Level generator is now a separate menu item
- Bigger damage area for explosions
- Updated menus and options
- Zoomed in closer to the action by default (can adjust with - and +)
- Tweaked random level generation

If you're interested in our new game, Gorilla Guerrillas, you can check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274530/Gorilla_Guerrillas/

notes.title: Update: Fixes and Additions
notes.notes:
We've just released an update for Steampunk Graveyard which includes fixes to a few issues raised by players, adds greater variation in the generated levels, and includes a small story segment to help add context to the game.

Main changes:
- Near screen enemies continue to patrol so will come back on screen
- Updated boss weapon behaviour to target player better
- 2 second invulnerability after initial damage of landing in thorns so you can slash them or jump away
- Added environment variations with different trees, flowers, sky, etc.
- Added more level layout variations with slopes, dips, etc.
- Added small story segment for context of the Baron's motivation

We hope you enjoy this update and look forward to adding more improvements in the future.

notes.title: Update, Bundle and Linux
notes.notes:
We're releasing another update based on player feedback to make [i][b]Steampunk Graveyard[/b][/i] better and fix a few small issues.

Changes in this update include:
[list]
[*] Added climb animation for player using ladder
[*] Removed Jump action from Climb Up button
[*] Switched gamepad Shoot and Jump controls
[*] Melee weapon more useful - cut vines or hit grenades
[*] Added more level layout variation
[*] Fixed issue with muted music in Options
[*] Changed end condition - destroy cannon, no need to catch balloon
[*] Windowed Mode in Options (can still use Alt+Enter or F11 to toggle)
[*] Default zoom much closer in (can still use -+ to change zoom)
[/list]

[i][b]Steampunk Graveyard[/b][/i] is now in a complete the set bundle with one of our other games, [i][b]Pirate Island Rescue[/b][/i], giving a 10% discount.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9318/

We're also making support for Linux for [i][b]Steampunk Graveyard[/b][/i] official and removing it from beta. We'll be looking to add linux support for our other titles in the near future.

notes.title: Linux Support Beta
notes.notes:
We're currently in the process of testing Linux support for [i][b]Steampunk Graveyard[/b][/i] and have set up Steam Beta builds.

To opt in, players will need to right-click the game in the [b]Library[/b], select [b]Properties[/b], go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select the appropriate beta version.

If anyone encounters any problems, please let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/956430/discussions]Forums[/url] or email support@badlogicstudios.com

We hope to make Linux support official very soon.

This is all possible thanks to our friends at https://linuxgameconsortium.com/

notes.title: A new update
notes.notes:
We've released a small update to [i][b]Steampunk Graveyard[/b][/i] with some changes based on player feedback, which should make the game even more fun to play.

Features of this update include:
[list]
[*] New boss weapon: balloon mounted rocket launcher - destroy it before you can catch a ride
[*] New obstacle: thorny bushes - watch out for the warning signs!
[*] New enemy: more brain-powered robots wandering around
[*] New level design elements: blocked upper tunnels & pits into the lower tunnels
[*] New difficulty selection: prompted to choose on first play, can still change in Options
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements & Stats
notes.notes:
We've just released our first small update for Steampunk Graveyard to enable Achievements & Stats.

The achievements are based on stats for completing graveyards and killing zombies, so now you can better track your progress and give more incentive to play the procedurally generated levels.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705266/feb3a25bd092b749151be3d5b5237d4b65ec13b1.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705266/c5463ba749f5702652980cf7556d4a98c076c382.png[/img]

We hope you like this update and if you have suggestions for any improvements or fixes for future updates we would be happy to hear them.

notes.title: It's alive!
notes.notes:
The day has come and Steampunk Graveyard is now live on Steam, with a 20% discount that will run for a week over the Halloween period.

It's time for the mechanically enhanced Professor Selene Gasket to journey from graveyard to graveyard to put an end to the ghoulish plans of her former mentor, Baron Richter von Sprocket.

Armed with a revolver, powerful explosives, and spring-loaded blades, will you as Selene venture into caverns below the graveyards to shoot, blast and slice your way through steel and flesh as you thwart the Baron's plans and destroy his piston powered zombie automatons and grenade throwing robotic brain-drones?
